observations: PS4 Fat console covered in a grey and black camouflage skin.
A black third-party controller styled after a PS5 DualSense, featuring a 'Turbo' button in the center.
Large watermark 'STEVAN ZIDIRI' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' across all photos.
No cables, power cord, or HDMI shown.
No photos of the console powered on or displaying a screen.

Requires a photo of the console's home screen showing the installed game icons.
EA Sports FC 27 does not exist; the current versions are FC 24 or FC 25.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard retail console.

risks.proof: Photo of the 'Storage' menu in system settings.

proof_requests: Photo of the System Information screen showing the software version.
Photo of the console's home screen showing the installed games.
Photo of the Storage settings showing the hard drive capacity.
Video of the console powered on and being operated by the included controller.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a PS4 Fat console. Although the 'hacked' status and game list are unverified and contain errors (FC 27), the item can be priced at the worst-case value of a standard 500GB PS4 Fat with a non-original controller.
